title: Dispatch: 7gkh dawn per-period economy readiness + Bag of Tricks engine-computed next-dawn ending (attempt 1, Sonnet)
description:
Implements eshyra-7gkh. Read `bd show eshyra-7gkh` first: its description (RECONCILED 2026-10-18) and acceptance criteria are the spec. Also read docs/rules-pack-compiler.md and docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. The importer protocol is MANDATORY if the generated pack changes. Locate code by symbol name. Base: origin/main eb52f97c. olc5.14 (PR #674) and olc5.15 (PR #675) are merged: the vessels now have count 1 and are owned, so their operations are blocked ONLY by c1-uses.

CODE SURVEY (verified by the captain)
- Hook: 'F5: per-period usage reset', from the perDawn helper in magicItemUseEconomies.ts. It is on c1-uses of 20 items and is NOT in LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS (magicItemCompiler.ts). Its sibling 'F5: dawn reset with nonblocking early-reuse risk' IS landed.
- Economy shape: {kind: 'per-day', perDay: {uses: N}, reset: [{at: 'dawn', amount: 'all'}]}. N is 1 for 19 items and 3 for Bag of Tricks. Crystal Ball of Telepathy carries it at variant scope.
- Execution: state/itemResetExecutor.ts. validateResetShape accepts dawn/all. crossedBoundaryEvents emits 'dawn' at minute 360 of each day as elapsed time advances. resetItem restores economies at the boundary. canRegain blocks consumed/nonmagical.
- use_item spends per-day uses in itemState.ts.

PART 1: EXECUTION FINDING (do first, record in notes)
- Determine with a real-pack probe whether, for this exact economy shape, use_item spends to exhaustion, then refuses at 0 (hard limit, unlike the nonblocking early-reuse hook), and a time advance across the next dawn restores the uses.
- If it does, the gap is ONLY readiness classification.
- If a binding is missing, implement exactly that binding, not a new reset engine. Record which case applied, with file:line citations.

PART 2: READINESS
- If every one of the 20 carriers has the identical executed contract, add 'F5: per-period usage reset' to LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS with a comment naming the executor.
- If any carrier differs, own the hook per clause instead (the activationEconomyOwned pattern) and keep the different ones pending, with the reason.
- Pipes of the Sewers carries F5 'magic-item-usage-recharge'. Determine whether that is the same executed contract. Own it if so; otherwise record it as a residual, with the reason.
- Regenerate the pack and add the thaw note.
- EXPECTED: the four elemental vessel operations become READY. Their m4 grants are owned since olc5.14. Other items' operations may become ready too; list every newly ready operation.

PART 3: BAG OF TRICKS NEXT-DAWN ENDING
- Source: "The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 hit points."
- ITEM_GRANT_REVERT_DISPOSITIONS (state/activeEffects.ts) maps 'next-dawn' to {kind: 'dm-ended'}.
- DECISION: make next-dawn ENGINE-COMPUTED using the SAME dawn boundary as the reset executor (minute 360 of the day; reuse the boundary helper, do not duplicate the constant). At bind, the effect's end is the first dawn boundary STRICTLY after the bind time, through the existing effect timer/expiry path (no new clock service).
- Add 'next-dawn' to ENGINE_COMPUTED_GRANT_ENDINGS (magicItemGrantOwnership.ts) and update the runtime table. The ownership test pins those two to each other.
- Bag of Tricks then owns its m4 if nothing else blocks it. Its creature comes from a d8 roll on the bag's color table, which stays DM-adjudicated. Its bonus-action command budget is F2 control, already split as adjudicated by c58j for owned grants: give it a control clause like the others.
- If the existing effect expiry cannot carry a computed absolute end time, STOP and record (leave the bead open). Do not build a clock service.
- Pipes of the Sewers (no printed ending) and the owner-command endings stay DM-ended.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE (minimum; no per-item matrix)
- ONE real-pack, no-waiver conformance for the shared per-day/dawn shape on one carrier: spend to exhaustion, refused at 0, restored by a time advance across dawn, and not restored by an advance that stops before dawn.
- For each NEWLY READY grant operation (the vessels; the Bag if it becomes ready), add it to CONFORMANCE_BACKED in itemGrantRealPackReadiness.test.ts, with a real-pack no-waiver bind test. One test that loops over the vessels is fine.
- Bag: one real-pack bind that ends at the next dawn and is still active on an advance stopping before dawn. The 0-HP ending is unchanged.
- Update the ownership test, baselines and census pins without weakening them.

VERIFY: run the focused suites, `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`, and `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing.
notes:
Dispatched 2026-10-26 as a Claude Sonnet 5.5 Agent in .worktrees/eshyra-7gkh.1, on branch eshyra-7gkh.1, cut from eshyra-7gkh @ eb52f97c (runs in parallel with the other dispatch, on disjoint files).
COMPLETION (commit d6ad6406e5d68587c08c13d7bfdf2cf1611f4fc4 on branch eshyra-7gkh.1, not pushed).
VERIFY: npm run verify:worktree exit 0 (377 files passed, 7117 tests passed, 3 skipped); npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exit 0 (committed pack matches importer output).
PART 1 FINDING (no missing binding; gap was ONLY readiness classification): useItem (state/itemState.ts ~L2765-2790) spends per-day uses and throws 'insufficient uses' when remaining<amount for a cost with no onExhausted marker (hard limit); resetItem/resolveDueItemClockEvents (state/itemResetExecutor.ts validateResetShape dawn/all; crossedBoundaryEvents dawn = minute 360) restore to maximum at the boundary. All 20 carriers have the identical economy {per-day, perDay.uses N (1; Bag 3), reset [{dawn, all}]} and a hard-limit cost (Crystal Ball at variant scope). Real-pack proof: packages/core/test/itemPerDayDawnEconomy.test.ts (Iron Bands of Binding, no waiver: spend, refused at 0, no restore at minute 359, restored at 360).
COUNTS: per-period usage reset missing-hook clauses 20 -> 0 (20 items). Magic-item clauses: engine-pending 782 -> 761, green 235 -> 256, adjudicated 367 -> 368, total 1385 -> 1386 (Bag m4 entityGrant went green + new hook-free m4-control-bag-of-tricks clause). Only records.json changed in the pack; no records added/removed. records.json sha256 19bb62635233507dd887a447235b904173073ef7f2e2d4f16577a27927ed7d44. Thaw note: docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-10-26-eshyra-7gkh-1-dawn-economy-readiness.md.
NEWLY READY OPERATIONS (12): Bag of Tricks pull-fuzzy-object; Bowl summon-water-elemental; Brazier summon-fire-elemental; Censer summon-air-elemental; Stone summon-earth-elemental; Cape of the Mountebank cast-dimension-door; Circlet of Blasting cast-scorching-ray; Crystal Ball (crystal-ball-of-telepathy) cast-suggestion; Dragon Scale Mail sense-nearest-dragon; Iron Bands of Binding throw-bands; Plate Armor of Etherealness gain-etherealness; Rod of Rulership command-obedience. Other carriers (armor of invulnerability, cloak of arachnida/bat, dagger of venom, helm of telepathy, javelin, pearl, rod of alertness) have other pending clauses and stay not ready.
PIPES FINDING: NOT the same contract -> residual. Pipes of the Sewers' F5 magic-item-usage-recharge is a charges economy with dice-valued partial regain (1d3 at dawn) and a variable cost, on a hook shared by 207 clauses of 53 items; not landed. Pipes also keeps m4 (no printed ending) so it could not become ready regardless. Follow-up bead filed (see below).
NEXT-DAWN IMPLEMENTATION: new state/worldClockBoundaries.ts holds MINUTES_PER_DAY, DAWN/DUSK_MINUTE_OF_DAY, crossedBoundaries (moved from itemResetExecutor, which now imports it) and nextDawnAfter (= first crossedBoundaries dawn in (now, now+1440], strictly after). activeEffects.ts: ITEM_GRANT_REVERT_DISPOSITIONS next-dawn -> {kind:'next-dawn'}; ItemGrantBinding.untilNextDawn; createActiveEffect requires duration exactly timed/minute/(nextDawn-now)/effect-created with no provenance/override (refuses a typed duration coexisting with next-dawn). toolStartEffect.ts fills that duration when omitted, refuses durationOverride. Uses the existing elapsed-world deadline + expireElapsedWorldEffects sweep (no clock service). ENGINE_COMPUTED_GRANT_ENDINGS += next-dawn; Bag CONTROL_SPANS entry (verbatim bonus-action sentences). Bag owns its m4. Tests: itemGrantRealPackReadiness.test.ts (4 vessels use->bind real pack; Bag ends at dawn, still active at 359 min, bound at exactly dawn ends a day later, 0-HP ending unchanged, until-removed/override refused); CONFORMANCE_BACKED += Bag + 4 vessels. Updated pins: magicItemCompiler, magicItemGrantOwnership (Bag OWNED; independent rule + counterfactuals), magicItemOperationSourceAgreement READY, srdGeneratedPack counts/1386, itemGrantBindCredit/itemGrantSummons (Bag bind now omits duration), semi-structured boundary inventory regenerated (1862 rows), capability inventory (worldClockBoundaries.ts owner on advance_time).
DEVIATIONS: (1) Added a new tiny module worldClockBoundaries.ts instead of exporting from itemResetExecutor, to avoid an activeEffects<->itemResetExecutor import cycle; still one definition of the constants. (2) Two stale test comments/tests that asserted next-dawn was DM-ended were updated (counterfactual now uses owner-dies; added a next-dawn-owned counterfactual) - intent preserved, not weakened. (3) Boundary inventory + capability inventory edits were required follow-through, not in the plan.
